sentences.text: 3] Counsel for the applicant, at the outset, has submitted that the case of the present applicant is identical to that of co-accused Rakesh Porwal, who has already been granted anticipatory bail by this court in M.Cr.C. No.22534 of 2022 dated 11.05.2022.

Thus, it is prayed that on the ground of parity,
present application be allowed.

4] Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer, and it is submitted that NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:29050 2 MCRC-43341-2025 case-diary is not available.
5] Heard.

Considering the fact that the applicant's wife had also deposited around Rs.3 lakh in Swaraj India Multipurpose Co-operative Society, whereas the applicant happens to be the salaried Jeevan Vishvkarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120650521/

sentences.text: 1 employee of Swaraj India Real Estate Limited, and taking note of the fact that co-accused Rakesh Porwal, who had also invested the amount in the company, has already been granted anticipatory bail, this Court finds that a case of parity is made out by the present applicant.
6] Accordingly, maintaining the parity, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail,
upon his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only)
and furnishing one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
He shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
7] Accordingly, MCRC stands allowed.
